hero.title: Art Director
hero.intro: Key visuals, integrated campaigns and brand systems for FMCG, mobility, aviation and tech brands in Indonesia.

projects.tagline: A new weapon in the arsenal
projects.headline: You can’t fight what you can’t name
projects.description: Fexofenadine 120mg went OTC, but many Indonesians still mistake allergic rhinitis for flu or masuk angin. We built a movement to make people name it first: the Sneeze Journal — a 5-part key visual series of educational and interactive social content.

projects.headline: One look, every sector
projects.description: Led the visual identity and key visuals for Shell’s B2B campaign — a sector-by-sector KV system for industrial lubricants, plus collaterals such as greeting cards and DVRs. Same grid, same red band, different industry heroes.

projects.tagline: A digital companion for breastfeeding mothers
projects.headline: Kisah, check-ins and care — in one place
projects.description: Website and product UI for Asifit, Kimia Farma’s breastfeeding supplement. Beyond the brand homepage, the experience gives mothers somewhere to return to: GEMAS, a daily check-in on mood and nutrition; Kisah Kasih Ibu, a space to share their stories; and a personal dashboard that turns their answers into gentle insights and recommendations.

projects.headline: Your gateway to the land of wonders
projects.description: Led visual development for a major tourism campaign targeting both local and international audiences — key visuals that capture the brand’s spirit across platforms, including a co-promo with Garuda Indonesia.

projects.headline: Establishing a pharmacy brand
projects.description: Key visuals to establish the Wellings pharmacy brand in Indonesia, backing the company’s 2023 ambition.

projects.headline: Three flavours, one way to refresh
projects.description: Visual direction and identity for RELX’s H2 launches — a summer beverage flavour series (Orange Juice, Cherry Cola, Triple Berry Punch) and an open-system device — plus a refresh of the brand’s social visuals to match the new tone.

projects.headline: On-ground, in-app, on feed
projects.description: Drivers, warung owners and resellers want extra income rooted in a dream of a better life. Klub Cuan turned that into an integrated push: in-app gamification, booths at pasar and tier-2 malls, social amplification and push reminders.

projects.headline: Two exhibitions, one booth
projects.description: Key visuals to open ISA Art + Design’s booth at Art Jakarta 2019. H.E.R celebrated female artists shaping the art world; Square One showcased legacy works by renowned artists. Each needed its own voice while sitting side by side in the same space.

projects.headline: Social & owned channels
projects.description: Oversaw the visual direction for XL Axiata’s digital platforms — guiding the Junior Art Director on social and owned-channel content, including the CEO’s social media, for consistency and quality.

projects.headline: From logo to the runway
projects.description: Led the rebranding of Pelita Air as it moved into commercial flight — livery design, supergraphics and in-flight materials such as the safety card.

projects.tagline: Booking that feels like the brand
projects.headline: Home, booking and checkout
projects.description: After the rebrand, Pelita Air needed its new identity to work where customers actually book. I designed the mobile app UI so finding a flight, choosing seats and paying feels quick and calm, and carries the same colours and supergraphic energy as the aircraft.

projects.headline: A mark that moves
projects.description: Full branding for a B2B electric-vehicle transport service — logo design, vehicle livery and supporting materials such as seat covers and video content.

projects.headline: One identity, digital and physical
projects.description: Lead Art Director and designer for INVI — social visuals and vehicle livery, keeping one visual identity across digital and physical touchpoints.

projects.tagline: A new entrant, built for Indonesia
projects.headline: From packaging to content
projects.description: Led visual development for a new player in the heated-tobacco category — brand strategy execution, product branding and every visual asset from packaging to content, tailored for Indonesia.

projects.headline: Food, bakery, coffee — one system
projects.description: Brand guidelines covering logo usage, photo direction, tone of voice and palette.

projects.tagline: A calmer first impression for a law firm
projects.headline: Website homepage
projects.description: Sandiva had just refreshed its visual identity and wanted a website to match. I designed a homepage that feels light and approachable, with a soft photographic backdrop and clear structure, for a profession people usually find intimidating.

about.statement: I turn ideas into compelling visuals — building brands, executing campaigns and crafting imagery that
about.bio: I’m an Art Director based in Jakarta with 8+ years in graphic design, leading creative teams and driving visual strategy. My approach blends strategic thinking with strong visual execution, for clear and impactful results.

capabilities.title: I find the real problem first
capabilities.description: Briefs usually describe a symptom. Before I open a layout, I look for the tension underneath: what people actually believe, and what stops them from acting. For Telfast, that meant noticing that people mistake allergic rhinitis for flu or masuk angin, so the campaign had to help them name it before it could sell them anything.

capabilities.title: One frame the whole campaign hangs on
capabilities.description: A campaign lives or dies on its key visual. I push for the single image that explains the idea without a caption, then build it until it holds up on a billboard and still reads in a 4:5 feed.

capabilities.title: Systems that flex without breaking
capabilities.description: Clients rarely need one beautiful poster. They need fifty pieces that still look like the same brand. I design the grid, the rules and the recurring device so teams and agencies can keep producing without diluting it. For Shell, that was one red band carrying a different industry hero in every sector.

capabilities.title: Brands built to be seen at speed
capabilities.description: An aircraft, a bus and a charging station each give you about two seconds of attention. My livery and supergraphic work is about recognition in motion: bold shapes, disciplined colour and identities that read from across the street or the runway.

capabilities.title: From the booth to the app
capabilities.description: An idea has to work everywhere the audience actually is. I carry one line across in-app, social, OOH, print and on-ground activations, like GrabKios’ Klub Cuan, which ran from booths in traditional markets to gamification inside the app.

capabilities.title: Design people can use, not just look at
capabilities.description: More and more, the brand experience is a product. I bring art direction into websites and interfaces: clear flows, warm tone and visuals that make a feature feel like the brand. Asifit turned a supplement into a companion for new mothers.

capabilities.title: Leading the team to final
capabilities.description: For the past three years I’ve led creative teams: shaping direction, reviewing work and helping junior art directors and designers raise their craft without losing their own voice. I care as much about how the work gets made as about how it looks when it ships.

approach.title: Find the tension
approach.description: Slow down on the brief. Find the real tension behind the ask before touching a layout.

approach.title: Commit early
approach.description: Commit to one sharp idea and one visual direction early, and with conviction.

approach.title: Nail the key visual
approach.description: The single frame the whole campaign hangs on.

approach.title: Carry it everywhere
approach.description: TVC, OOH, print, digital and on-ground — all on one line.

capabilities_intro: Eight years and five studios taught me that the work clients remember rarely starts with a moodboard. It starts with a sharp read of the problem, then one idea strong enough to survive every format it gets pushed into. This is what I bring to a team, and where you can see it.
